items.control_name: Enforce OAuth2 / JWT Authorization on Apigee / API Gateways
items.description: All external APIs must require valid OAuth2 access tokens or JWT signatures validated at the API Gateway edge.
items.current_value: 100% of production API routes enforce JWT verification with short TTL (< 15 min)
items.recommended_value: Mandatory OAuth2 / JWT verification on all published API endpoints
items.remediation_notes: Implement Apigee rate-limiting and spike arrest policies.

items.control_name: Enforce Secret Manager for All Application Credentials & Auto-Rotation
items.description: Applications must fetch DB passwords and API tokens from GCP Secret Manager; no plain-text secrets in environment variables.
items.current_value: 18 secrets stored in Secret Manager; 2 legacy services use plain-text env vars
items.recommended_value: 100% Secret Manager adoption with Cloud Function automatic 90-day rotation
items.remediation_notes: Migrate legacy DB connection strings to Secret Manager and configure rotation schedule.

items.control_name: Enable Artifact Registry Automatic Vulnerability Scanning
items.description: Container images pushed to Artifact Registry must undergo automatic vulnerability scanning for CVEs before deployment.
items.current_value: On-push vulnerability scanning active; 4 high CVEs detected in 'base-python-image'
items.recommended_value: Automatic CVE scanning enabled with CI/CD build break on Critical/High CVEs
items.remediation_notes: Update base images and patch OpenSSL/Python dependencies.

items.control_name: Enforce Binary Authorization on GKE and Cloud Run
items.description: Only container images signed by authorized CI/CD attestors may be deployed to production GKE clusters and Cloud Run services.
items.current_value: Binary Authorization policy deployed in Report-Only mode on Cloud Run
items.recommended_value: Enforced Binary Authorization policy requiring valid CI/CD attestation
items.remediation_notes: Switch Binary Authorization mode from Report-Only to Enforce for production project.
